statement.ru: Медоносная пчела, ужалив человека, улетает живой и может жалить снова.
statement.en: A honeybee that stings a person flies off alive and can sting again.

why: False: the barbed sting tears out of a worker honeybee's abdomen in mammal skin and the bee dies.

statement.ru: Взрослая подёнка живёт с пустым желудком — он заполнен воздухом.
statement.en: An adult mayfly lives with an empty gut, filled with air.

why: True: adult mayflies do not feed, have vestigial mouthparts and an air-filled digestive system.

statement.ru: По числу точек на спинке божьей коровки можно узнать её возраст.
statement.en: You can tell a ladybird's age by the number of its spots.

why: False: spot count depends on the species, not age.

statement.ru: Муравьи-листорезы несут листья домой, чтобы выращивать на них грибы.
statement.en: Leafcutter ants carry leaves home to grow fungus on them.

why: True: the cut leaves feed a fungus garden, and the fungus feeds the larvae.

statement.ru: Комар может заразить человека ВИЧ, если до этого укусил больного.
statement.en: A mosquito can give someone HIV after biting an infected person.

why: False: HIV cannot infect or survive in mosquitoes, so they cannot pass it on.

statement.ru: Таракан без головы может прожить несколько недель.
statement.en: A cockroach can live for weeks without its head.

why: True: it breathes through spiracles on its body; headless roaches live for weeks.

statement.ru: Учёные до сих пор не могут объяснить, как летает шмель.
statement.en: Scientists still can't explain how a bumblebee flies.

why: False: the 'bees can't fly' story is a myth from a simplified 1930s calculation; dynamic stall explains it.

statement.ru: У сверчка уши — на передних ногах.
statement.en: A cricket's ears are on its front legs.

why: True: the tympanal organs sit on the tibiae of the front legs.

statement.ru: Дыры в шерстяном свитере прогрызают взрослые бабочки моли.
statement.en: The holes in a wool jumper are chewed by adult clothes moths.

why: False: adult clothes moths do not feed at all; only the caterpillars eat wool.

statement.ru: Когда-то жили родичи стрекоз с размахом крыльев около 70 см.
statement.en: Relatives of dragonflies once lived with a wingspan of about 70 cm.

why: True: Meganeura, a Carboniferous griffinfly related to dragonflies, had a wingspan of 65 to 75 cm.

statement.ru: Обычная комнатная муха живёт около года.
statement.en: An ordinary housefly lives for about a year.

why: False: adult houseflies normally live two to four weeks.

statement.ru: Есть цикады, которые 17 лет сидят под землёй, а потом вылезают все разом.
statement.en: Some cicadas spend 17 years underground, then all come out at once.

why: True: periodical cicada nymphs live 13 or 17 years underground and emerge together.

statement.ru: Одна пчела за всю жизнь приносит целую столовую ложку мёда.
statement.en: One bee makes a whole tablespoon of honey in its lifetime.

why: False: about 1/12 of a teaspoon, some 36 times less than a tablespoon.

statement.ru: Светлячки — это жуки.
statement.en: Fireflies are beetles.

why: True: fireflies are beetles (family Lampyridae).

statement.ru: Одна и та же бабочка-монарх летит из Канады в Мексику и обратно.
statement.en: The same monarch butterfly flies from Canada to Mexico and back.

why: False: the return north takes several generations; the autumn migrants are not the spring ones.

statement.ru: Ближайшая родня термитов — тараканы, а не муравьи.
statement.en: Termites' closest relatives are cockroaches, not ants.

why: True: termites are highly derived cockroaches (order Blattodea), not related to ants.

statement.ru: Вошь умеет перепрыгивать с головы на голову.
statement.en: A head louse can jump from one head to another.

why: False: head lice cannot fly or jump; they crawl from hair to hair.

statement.ru: В блошиных цирках выступали настоящие блохи.
statement.en: Real fleas performed in flea circuses.

why: True: fleas were harnessed with thin gold or copper wire; real flea circuses ran until the 2010s.

statement.ru: Стрекоза умеет летать задом наперёд.
statement.en: A dragonfly can fly backwards.

why: True: dragonflies can fly in six directions, backwards included.

statement.ru: Глаз стрекозы состоит примерно из сотни крошечных глазков.
statement.en: A dragonfly's eye is made of about a hundred tiny eyes.

why: False: each compound eye has nearly 24,000 ommatidia.

statement.ru: Бывает, что бабочки пьют слёзы черепах.
statement.en: Butterflies sometimes drink the tears of turtles.

why: True: butterflies have been seen drinking tears of turtles and crocodiles, for the salt.

statement.ru: У человека мышц больше, чем у гусеницы.
statement.en: A human has more muscles than a caterpillar.

why: False: Lyonet counted 4,041 muscles in one caterpillar; a human has about 650.

statement.ru: Каждый четвёртый известный вид животных — жук.
statement.en: One in four known animal species is a beetle.

why: True: about 400,000 beetle species, about 25% of all animal species.

statement.ru: Навозный жук ночью находит дорогу по Млечному Пути.
statement.en: At night a dung beetle finds its way by the Milky Way.

why: True: Scarabaeus satyrus navigates by the Milky Way when only it is visible.

statement.ru: Все муравьи на Земле вместе весят больше, чем все люди.
statement.en: All the ants on Earth together weigh more than all the people.

why: False: a 2022 PNAS study puts ant biomass at about 20% of human biomass.

statement.ru: В наводнение огненные муравьи сцепляются в живой плот и плывут.
statement.en: In a flood, fire ants link up into a living raft and float.

why: True: fire ants link together into a floating ball or raft, the queen inside.

statement.ru: Осы строят гнёзда из бумаги, которую делают сами, жуя древесину.
statement.en: Wasps build nests from paper they make themselves by chewing wood.

why: True: paper wasps mix wood and plant fibres with saliva into a paper-like material.

statement.ru: Шмели надкусывают листья растений, чтобы те быстрее зацвели.
statement.en: Bumblebees nibble plant leaves to make them flower sooner.

why: True: Science 2020: pollen-starved bumblebees bite leaves; tomatoes flowered up to 30 days early.

statement.ru: Одиночную и стайную саранчу когда-то считали разными видами.
statement.en: Solitary and swarming locusts were once thought to be different species.

why: True: Uvarov showed that Locusta migratoria and 'L. danica' were two phases of one species.

statement.ru: Цветы какао опыляют крошечные мошки.
statement.en: Cocoa flowers are pollinated by tiny midges.

why: True: cacao is pollinated by Forcipomyia biting midges.

statement.ru: Мухи-журчалки, похожие на ос, тоже больно жалят.
statement.en: Hoverflies, which look like wasps, sting painfully too.

why: False: hoverflies only mimic wasps; they are harmless flies with no sting.

statement.ru: Кровь у кузнечика красная, как у человека.
statement.en: A grasshopper's blood is red, like a human's.

why: False: insect haemolymph has no haemoglobin; it is clear to greenish.

statement.ru: Комариный писк — это голос комара.
statement.en: A mosquito's whine is its voice.

why: False: the whine is the sound of its wings beating hundreds of times a second.

statement.ru: Самка богомола всегда съедает самца после спаривания.
statement.en: A female mantis always eats the male after mating.

why: False: in the wild about a quarter of encounters end with the male eaten.

statement.ru: Если потрогать крылья бабочки, она больше не сможет летать.
statement.en: If you touch a butterfly's wings, it can never fly again.

why: False: the Lepidopterists' Society calls it a myth; butterflies lose scales all the time and still fly.

statement.ru: Уховёртки нарочно заползают людям в уши.
statement.en: Earwigs crawl into people's ears on purpose.

why: False: earwigs are not known to climb into ears on purpose; the name is a myth.

statement.ru: Чем теплее, тем чаще стрекочет сверчок.
statement.en: The warmer it is, the faster a cricket chirps.

why: True: chirp rate rises with temperature (Dolbear's law).

statement.ru: В Антарктиде живёт насекомое, которого больше нигде нет.
statement.en: An insect lives in Antarctica that is found nowhere else.

why: True: the flightless midge Belgica antarctica is endemic to Antarctica.

statement.ru: Бабочка тутового шелкопряда разучилась летать.
statement.en: The domestic silk moth has lost the ability to fly.

why: True: the domesticated silk moth is not capable of functional flight.

statement.ru: Тля может родиться уже беременной.
statement.en: An aphid can be born already pregnant.

why: True: telescoping generations: embryos already develop inside the unborn young.

statement.ru: Бабочки живут всего один день.
statement.en: Butterflies live for only one day.

why: False: adult butterflies live from a week to nearly a year, depending on the species.

statement.ru: Когда светлячок светится, его брюшко нагревается, как лампочка.
statement.en: When a firefly glows, its belly heats up like a light bulb.

why: False: fireflies make 'cold light' with no infrared.

statement.ru: Бабочка-монарх ядовита для птиц.
statement.en: A monarch butterfly is poisonous to birds.

why: True: monarchs store cardenolides from milkweed and are toxic and foul-tasting.

statement.ru: Есть тараканы, которые громко шипят, выдувая воздух.
statement.en: Some cockroaches hiss loudly by blowing out air.

why: True: the Madagascar hissing cockroach forces air out through its spiracles.

statement.ru: У трутней — пчёл-самцов — нет жала.
statement.en: Drones, the male bees, have no sting.

why: True: unlike female workers, a drone has no stinger.
